1: import http from 'node:http';
2: import { timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
3: 
4: const upstream = new URL(process.env.MODEL_UPSTREAM || 'http://192.168.142.130:8317');
5: const master = process.env.MODEL_MASTER_KEY;
6: const token = process.env.ENV_MODEL_TOKEN;
7: if (!master || !token) throw new Error('Missing MODEL_MASTER_KEY or ENV_MODEL_TOKEN');
8: if (upstream.protocol !== 'http:' || upstream.pathname !== '/' || upstream.search || upstream.username || upstream.password) {
9:   throw new Error('This fixed gateway requires an administrator configured HTTP origin');
10: }
11: const model = 'gpt-5.6-luna';
12: let active = 0;
13: function reply(res: http.ServerResponse, code: number, message: string) {
14:   res.writeHead(code, {'Content-Type':'application/json','Cache-Control':'no-store'});
15:   res.end(JSON.stringify({error:{message}}));
16: }
17: const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
18:   if (req.url === '/health' && req.method === 'GET') { res.end('ok'); return; }
19:   const received = Buffer.from(req.headers.authorization || '');
20:   const expected = Buffer.from('Bearer ' + token);
21:   if (received.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(received, expected)) { reply(res,401,'Unauthorized'); return; }
22:   if (req.url === '/v1/models' && req.method === 'GET') {
23:     res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');
24:     res.end(JSON.stringify({object:'list',data:[{id:model,object:'model',owned_by:'approved-gateway'}]})); return;
25:   }
26:   if (req.method !== 'POST' || !['/v1/chat/completions','/v1/responses'].includes(req.url || '')) { reply(res,404,'Unsupported route'); return; }
27:   if (active >= 2) { reply(res,429,'Model gateway is busy'); return; }
28:   active++;
29:   let completed = false;
30:   const finish = () => { if (!completed) { completed=true; active--; } };
31:   res.once('close', finish);
32:   let size=0;
33:   const chunks:Buffer[]=[];
34:   try {
35:     for await (const chunk of req) {
36:       size += chunk.length;
37:       if (size > 16*1024*1024) { reply(res,413,'Request too large'); return; }
38:       chunks.push(chunk);
39:     }
40:     const body=Buffer.concat(chunks);
41:     let data:Record<string,unknown>;
42:     try { data=JSON.parse(body.toString()); } catch { reply(res,400,'Invalid JSON'); return; }
43:     if (!data || data.model !== model) { reply(res,403,'Only the approved model is allowed'); return; }
44:     const request=http.request(new URL(req.url!,upstream), {
45:       method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+master,'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':body.length},
46:     }, response => {
47:       res.writeHead(response.statusCode || 502, {
48:         'Content-Type':response.headers['content-type'] || 'application/json',
49:         'Cache-Control':'no-store','X-Accel-Buffering':'no',
50:       });
51:       response.pipe(res);
52:       response.on('error',()=>res.destroy());
53:     });
54:     const deadline=setTimeout(()=>request.destroy(new Error('model deadline')),300000);
55:     res.once('close',()=>{clearTimeout(deadline);request.destroy();});
56:     request.on('error',()=>{ if (!res.headersSent) reply(res,502,'Approved model unavailable; no automatic retry'); else res.destroy(); });
57:     request.end(body);
58:   } catch { if (!res.headersSent && !res.destroyed) reply(res,400,'Invalid request'); }
59:   finally { if (res.writableEnded || res.destroyed) finish(); }
60: });
61: server.requestTimeout=30000;
